body: Do quests. Get seeds. Use seeds to unlock nodes for rewards. Appears to reset weekly.

author: AkumaFexin
body: Well... It does come with a little tutorial. It is essentially a little rewards track. There are new daily/weekly quests (listed when you open the quest tab) you can complete to receive the seeds needed to activate the next rewards node. The rewards track rests every seven days, aka every Saturday (at least for me in the eu). And then you can make your way through it again. Depending on what you're missing you can choose one of the four branches to progress on. Though I think the most useful one is probably orns if you wanna push ascension lvl or all the crucible gear stuff.

author: DabawDaw
body:
Check out the Quest button on the bottom left of your world screen. Completing quests gives you currency to unlock those nodes.

Apparently it resets every week. So that's nice. You can get a bunch of Matts, currency, and special currency and some other stuff.
